text:
elaine: Heads-up — noticed our API reference for the file upload SSE stream only documents `data` chunks. The runtime also emits `progress` and `complete` event types. Need a quick docs PR to show the real SSE shape and update the Node/curl streaming samples.
chris: Good catch. Can you paste a minimal example of the SSE events? I can update the OpenAPI examples once we agree on the shape.
elaine: Sure. Example from the runtime (literal SSE lines):

```
event: progress
data: {"percent": 12}

event: data
data: {"chunk_id": "c1", "bytes": 8192}

event: progress
data: {"percent": 48}

event: data
data: {"chunk_id": "c2", "bytes": 16384}

event: complete
data: {"file_id": "f_123", "size": 24576}

```
elaine: Notes: `progress` carries a numeric percent (0-100), `data` is the same payload currently documented but may include `chunk_id`, and `complete` is the final meta object. `error` events are still possible for failures.
samir: Do we need to change the cURL example to use chunked transfer or just show parsing for SSE? The existing curl sample just uses `--no-buffer` and reads lines which is ambiguous.
chris: We should show both: a minimal curl that streams and a short Node example using `ReadableStream` parsing so users know how to handle `event:` prefixes. Also call out that `Content-Type: text/event-stream` is emitted by the server for the response.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 — updates /v1/uploads docs + adds Node and curl streaming snippets. Added test-case: example SSE log to fixtures/test-sse-upload.txt
elaine: Thanks. Two small ask items for eng-ml/runtime: 1) confirm the `progress` percent is integer vs float, 2) confirm `chunk_id` format (uuid vs short id). @eng-ml can you confirm?
eng-ml: Confirmed — percent is integer. chunk_id is a short base62 id (not a full UUID). We'll add a note in the API changelog entry for transparency.
samir: Also add migration note: older clients that expected only `data` should ignore unknown event types (i.e., treat unknown events as no-op). Add a one-liner in the docs.
chris: I’ll land the docs PR once CI passes. Action items: elaine add the SSE example text file, samir update curl + Node snippets, eng-ml confirm event shapes (done), docs-bot will link PR to changelog. Anything else?
elaine: One more — include a small Python snippet showing how to iterate lines and `if line.startswith('event:')` to separate events. Keep it short.
chris: Cool. I'll merge after the snippets are in and we add a short note under "Streaming responses" about `progress`/`complete` event types. :thumbsup:
